intro: Databases and research tools developed by the group.

products.name: CHAOS
products.full_name: Combinatorial High-throughput Analysis and Optimization for Synthesis
products.description: The first database of first-principles calculations dedicated to high-entropy oxides. Disordered oxides are stored as ensembles of relaxed DFT supercells, alongside their ordered binary and ternary reference oxides and structural and chemical descriptors. Registered users open a page for each disordered system, query the database through the REST API, or use CHAOS-Agent, a natural-language interface.

products.name: LOOP
products.description: A platform for high-entropy materials data. Browse experimental and literature results, upload new data, run synthesizability predictions, or access the data through the API.

products.name: Fusion Mirrors
products.description: Explore calculated optical constants and normal-incidence reflectivity by wavelength and chemical family. The current code-only preview opens an authorized local dataset in the browser; unpublished DFT data are not hosted here.

products.name: Synthesizability Game
products.description: Choose elements for the two cation sites and see whether the resulting composition is predicted to be synthesizable. We presented the game at the 2026 ARPA-E Energy Innovation Summit in San Diego.

products.name: XRD Phase ID
products.description: Upload a powder X-ray diffraction scan to identify its phases, refine their lattice parameters, assign each reflection and generate structure files. It works in the browser or through the API, with no sign-in.
